upstream_stage: Symbol candidates, deduplication and final OCR

actual_input.capture_note: Exact available recorded inputs. File/DOM/library objects may be represented as opaque metadata; raw byte/array references remain authoritative.

expected_input: Native BGR array and actual Canny/blur settings.

actual_output.capture_note: Return values are retained unchanged. captureError for JSON.stringify(undefined) is a recorder serialization limitation, not an application exception. Use observed resulting state for void methods.

expected_output_contract: Grayscale/blur/edge arrays in the same 1280×960 source frame. Image processing may change intensities, but must not imply a spatial crop/scale that was not performed.
expected_diagram: 15 cm is OCR-groundable focal length. Object/lens/image/ray positions and F spacing must be measured from the source. The drawing suggests the between-F-and-2F image-formation case; no exact object distance or annotated pixel coordinates are supplied.
finding: Arrays preserve the source frame. Blur and Canny change image information; no detector correctness is inferred from shape alone.
change_or_loss: Color/intensity information becomes an edge representation. Exact arrays are retained. OpenCV internal per-operation frames were not separately profiled.
